text:
sam: Heads-up— I'm seeing a persistent ~4.8% hard rejects from fncall in ap-east since 14:03 UTC. Rejects tag = INVALID_TOOL_SCHEMA.
tess: Got the alert too. Is this part of the strict-validator rollout?
eli: It was rolled to 8% in ap-east at 13:50 per deploybot. Thought adapters were normalized though.
maria: Sample (redacted) from console sampling: 
```json
{
  "tool": "price_lookup",
  "response": {
    "items": [],
    "meta": []
  },
  "req_id": "r_apx001"
}
```
validator expects `meta` to be an object map; seeing an empty array from older adapter path.
ops: We can flip soft-validate for impacted tenant shards to avoid user 400s. Which tenants are affected?
sam: Initial heatmap shows tenants t-88 and t-91 highest. Patch ETA from infra-adapters?
eli: I traced the adapter behavior: fallback code returns [] for `meta` when downstream returns no headers. Quick fix is to coerce []|null -> {} before sending to validator. I'll open a PR and cut a patch in ~12m.
tess: Console UX request: can we add a per-reject `raw_sample_link` (permissioned) and a short `reject_reason` field in the rejects table? Right now the masked sample hides shape issues and slows triage.
maria: Also propose a new console toggle: "enable-auto-fallback-for-validator-spikes". Knobs: threshold_pct, window_minutes, cooldown_minutes, and per-tenant opt-out. Ops can flip for emergencies.
ops: Ops notes: auto-fallback is useful but risky. If we auto-fallback to permissive it reduces 400s but may route to a different model variant with higher latency/cost. Need an audit log and a cost-estimate shown before enabling.
sam: Agreed. UX should show estimated p50 latency delta and monthly cost delta for the slice before enabling. Also require a two-step confirmation for region-wide toggles.
eli: Telemetry: please emit `validator.mode` and `validator.canary_pct` as trace/span tags. Right now traces are missing the rollout state so debugging is manual. Also add metrics: `fncall.validator.hard_rejects` and `fncall.validator.soft_validations` with labels region, tenant, rollout_slice.
tess: Sampling: propose we capture 0.5% of hard rejects with unmasked payloads into secure S3 (PII gated). RBAC to allow platform+oncall to fetch exact samples for triage. Retain for 7 days.
ops: We will enable soft-validate for t-88/t-91 now and create incident #4994. Monitor error budget and latency during soft-validate.
maria: I'll make a small dashboard tile: rejects pct vs canary pct and a sparkline for the last 60m per region. That should make it obvious when rollouts line up with rejects.
eli: Patch PR opened and tests green, cutting release now. Will post back when adapters landed and we can rollback soft-validate.
sam: One more idea: Console should surface a historic "validator affinity" chart showing which adapters/models commonly cause a given reject type. That helps speed up root-cause mapping.
tess: I'll file a UX ticket to add raw_sample_link (permissioned), reject_reason column, auto-fallback toggle UI with cost-estimate panel, and the affinity chart.
console-bot: deploybot: strict-validator canary enabled in ap-east at 13:50 UTC by eli
console-bot: opsbot: incident #4994 created "fncall validator rejects spike - ap-east" assigned to eng-platform
ops: Soft-validate enabled for t-88/t-91. Watching.
sam: Thanks. Once adapters are patched let's run a 5m canary check: rejects <0.5% before we revert soft-validate.
eli: Will ping here when rollout finishes and when I revert the soft-validate.
maria: Thanks everyone. Please add any follow-ups here and tag me for the dashboard PR.
